text:
jen: ok team — final quiet-window sanity check before we open traffic. Quick run: pin lifts, canary health, rollback triggers. I put the checklist below, pls ack.

jen: checklist:
• confirm release notes published (internal + external) -> https://redwood.infer/release/2026-03-v3.4.1
• confirm canary pinned to v3.4.1 on staging and prod shadow
• smoke tests green on eu and us regions
• fallback model variant available (v3.3.9-compat)
• rollback criteria set (>=5% errors 5m OR latency +200ms p95)
• ops oncall and eng rotation lined up

sam: acked. I'm watching canary metrics, will call rollback if error spike. :white_check_mark:

alex: release notes updated, security blurb included. external doc links live. :thumbsup:

maria: running smoke now on staging eu, passing generator + embed suite. ETA 2m.

deploy-bot: [canary-check] staging:v3.4.1 -> healthy
deploy-bot: [canary-check] prod-shadow:v3.4.1 -> healthy

jen: sam/maria — can you confirm pin/unpin sequence? We want to lift pins for low-traffic slices first.

sam: plan: unpin slice-a (5%) -> monitor 10m -> if ok unpin slice-b (25%) -> then full. I'll run manual unpin commands.

ethan-oncall: i'm standby for 30m. Slack + PagerDuty on. set threshold hooks already.

kat: I've uploaded rollback runbook to /docs/runbooks/rollbacks/v3.4.1.md and added an ops shortcut in console.

jen: executing unpin for slice-a. sam you'll own metric watch. tag me if anything.

deploy-bot: Executing: `deploy unpin --slice slice-a --model v3.4.1 --actor jen`
deploy-bot: Result: UNPIN SUCCESS (slice-a -> traffic 0.05)

sam: watching p99/p95 and error-rate. so far p95 +10ms, errors stable.

maria: staging smoke still green. no input regressions.

jen: ok proceed to slice-b unpin in 2m.

deploy-bot: Executing: `deploy unpin --slice slice-b --model v3.4.1 --actor jen`
deploy-bot: Result: PARTIAL -> some instances failed to attach route in eu-west-1 (5%), falling back to v3.3.9-compat for that subset.

sam: seeing increased 502s in eu-west-1 at 12:43:21 UTC, currently 4.8% errors — very close to threshold. Investigating. :rotating_light:

jen: decision time. do we abort full unpin and roll back slice-b to v3.3.9? Or try to revert those failing nodes to shadow routing?

maria: my logs show a CUDA OOM on a subset — likely a quant path mismatch on eu GPU driver 510 vs 515. We can toggle quant fallback quickly.

kat: ops shortcut can toggle fallback: `ops toggle-quant-fallback --region eu-west-1` (takes ~30s). Want me to flip?

sam: yes flip fallback now, then re-evaluate 2m. If errors <3% go ahead, else rollback slice-b to v3.3.9.

kat: toggling now.

deploy-bot: ops action: `ops toggle-quant-fallback --region eu-west-1` -> OK
deploy-bot: routing update: 12:44:05 UTC -> fallback enabled for eu-west-1

sam: errors dropping to 1.2% over last 30s. p95 stabilizing.

jen: nice. hold on further rollout for 5m then continue if stable. updating notes: we had a driver mismatch OOM; mitigation = quant-fallback toggle; ops will follow up with infra to align GPU driver windows.

maria: filing infra ticket with logs: INF-2026-2397. cc @infra-team.

ethan-oncall: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and escalate if anything.

jen: final: everyone please add short bullet to the release page about the unpin hiccup and the quick mitigation steps. I'll close the quiet-window at +15m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

alex: adding note now.

sam: ack. standby.

kat: re-enabled strict routing for us-region after slice-b stabilization.

deploy-bot: [summary] canary v3.4.1 partial rollout: slice-a unpinned -> ok; slice-b partial -> fallback toggled -> stabilized. No rollback required.

jen: thanks team — leaving this thread open until close time. If nothing else, I'll post final close.

(automated) deploy-bot: thread archived in 60m unless activity detected.
